An ancient '''script''' was used by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force users]] on both sides of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light]]<ref name="KotET">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref> and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark]],<ref name="Sacrifice">{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}}</ref> appearing on ancient temples and artifacts of both the Light and Dark Sides. The script was present on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], within a cave that helped access the information within the [[Datacron/Legends|Datacron]] of [[Ood Bnar]].<ref name="KotET" /> The script also appeared in the [[Tomb of Darth Bane/Legends|Tomb]] of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />
